scope: investigative admission criterion; not existing VectorCore project policy or release performance acceptance

readiness.processRateScope: comparable observed PID/executable pairs; identity changes reject; births/exits explicitly retained as unknown per-process work

continuation: A failed admission is retained as no-timing host-not-ready; no opportunistic retries. Any future batch needs separately documented changed host condition and complete predetermined schedule. Nominal schedule steps must be exactly15 s; actual starts are no earlier than target and at most1 s late; captures must not overlap; unchanged counter intervals reject.
limitations: CPU counters are whole-host aggregates, not per-core frequency or placement.
ps CPU time pairs omit processes that start or exit between snapshots; host aggregate still includes their CPU work.
A nominal OS thermal pressure value does not establish temperature or invariant clock speed.
No selected case retries or median/statistic/threshold/identity waivers.
